common_contracts.contract: Both read paths use identical per-choice projection: label=dispName; raw value=valueList (entire array); checked uses .toString equality to optional currentValueList. View defaultFlg and DEFAULT_VALUE_FLAG_ON are display names for checked current values. No factory default value, bit offset, bit merge or scalar conversion is computed by any of60 methods. Radio index retrieves original raw choice array in staging. Native V2/type81/type22/write fields and bit-level merge are native-owner joins.

Current authenticated six Customize members are one supplied frontend; they do not branch on NA/EU/JP, generation low5, DS4 table identity, bit fields, default-value metadata, MySet identity or type81/type22. Support arrays and exclusive child arrays pass through without frontend filtering; native catalog eligibility and labels enter DV000038/039. Native regions/generations and all12 DS4 source variants remain separate referenced joins, never frontend equivalence claims. No dedicated default/all-default action or MySet save/recall request is present in this full reachable frontend. Native all-default route remains independently assigned, not closed or declared unavailable.

Security createReturnValue initializes code=0, only changes OEM code inside customizeItemList.forEach, then tests projected length===0. With ordinary arrays, empty means no loop -> code0 -> code2. Code4 branch and controller case4 are retained as shipped branches but no current path in this producer reaches4. Do not invent an empty Subaru-exclusive route.

Worker ignores every fulfilled native setCustomize response including successList. It returns only {code:OEMroute}; rejected request alone maps resultInfo into resolved {isError:true,detailCode,code}. Controller normal fulfillment rereads regardless per-item statuses; error reread is deferred to error-dialog OK. Native global transport result and per-item success must remain separate in native composition.

DLG01 Cancel closes confirmation and preserves stage. Item Cancel/DLG06 Cancel clear selected/current/staged state and restore catalog. Progress and update dialogs have no buttons. No Customize wrapper registers a cancellation command, abort signal or generation guard; disposal empties DOM/drops references without joining pending promises. Native cancellation/disconnect behavior cannot be assigned from these bodies.
